messages:
erin (Billing Ops): Quick alert \u2014 two customers reported May invoices with problems: one PDF shows usage $0 (ledger has $320) and another customer received two different PDFs with the same invoice_id. attaching redacted snippet. :mag:

erin (Billing Ops): Snippet:
```
Invoice: 2025-05-INV-7701
Customer: acme-labs
PDF shows:
 - Reserved capacity: $500
 - Usage (tokens): $0    <-- should be $320
 - Tax: $40
 Total: $540
Ledger charge: $860
```

noah (FinOps): Can you confirm ledger vs invoice_lines? run quick recon: `SELECT invoice_id, sum(amount) FROM invoice_lines WHERE invoice_id='2025-05-INV-7701' GROUP BY invoice_id;`

erin (Billing Ops): Ran it  ledger and invoice_lines show $320 usage. invoice_pdfs table shows 2 entries for 2025-05-INV-8812 (different customer) and 1 pdf for 7701 that omits usage.

invoices-bot: ALERT: duplicate invoice_id detected for customer zeta-inc: 2025-05-INV-8812 (batch invoice_run_2025_05_31).

sophie (Payments): Pausing invoice email job and setting gateway holds for customers who reported duplicates. Don't want confused PDFs going out.

carlos (Support): I have an open ticket from Acme Labs. They're worried they were undercharged. We should reassure them charge is correct and we'll reissue corrected PDF.

noah (FinOps): Hypothesis: invoice-renderer feature flag 'compact_lines' was toggled in last renderer deploy and sometimes skips line templates on retry. @deploy-bot what rolled?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: invoice-renderer v2.4.0 -> prod at 1823456000 by ci/pipeline.

erin (Billing Ops): Proposed steps: 1) keep email job paused 2) mark affected invoices as pdf_needs_rerender 3) dedupe invoice_pdfs (keep the pdf whose totals match invoice_lines) 4) pin renderer to v2.3.8 or apply hotfix that protects line templates 5) re-render and resend corrected PDFs with note "Corrected invoice: no change to charged amount".

noah (FinOps): Also add a quick SQL to find any other mismatches: `SELECT i.invoice_id FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, sum(amount) as lines FROM invoice_lines GROUP BY invoice_id) l ON l.invoice_id=i.invoice_id WHERE i.period='2025-05' AND coalesce(l.lines,0)<>coalesce(i.usage_total,0);`

erin (Billing Ops): Ran sweep  found 6 mismatches across the May batch and 3 invoice_ids with duplicate PDFs. Creating ticket FIN-2025-330 and assigning to eng-render.

sophie (Payments): Thanks  I'll resume sends only after QA signoff and we'll include the short apology note.

carlos (Support): Drafting customer message now. Will hold on sending until you give the list.

erin (Billing Ops): FIN-2025-330 created with logs and affected invoice_ids. Assigning to eng-render. Will update when re-render completes. :white_check_mark:
